newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Two Israeli cable manufacturers discussing merger.
newsitem.headline: Two Israeli cable manufacturers discussing merger.

text.p: Wires & Cables Ltd and Cables of Zion Ltd, Israel's two largest manufacturers of power and telecommunications cable, are discussing a possible merger, Wires & Cables said on Wednesday.

"The company confirms that there were conversations recently between the company and representatives of the controlling shareholders in Cables of Zion United Works Ltd with the aim of exploring the possibility of joining operations against the background of increasing competition from foreign manufacturers," Wires & Cables said in a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
Cables of Zion is controlled by Clal Industries, while Cables is controlled by Yuli Ofer, an Israeli investor with interests in property and shipping.
The statement said the talks were in the early stages and the two sides had not agreed on a formula for continuing them. It added that any agreement would require approval from antitrust authorities.
Yechezkel Baron, managing director of Zion Cables, said he did not know how the merger would be done nor would he speculate on when it might occur.

The talks mark the two companies' second attempt at merging in the face of increased competition mainly from foreign producers. Both Bezeq Israel Telecom and Israel Electric Corp, which account for the vast majority of the two companies' sales, have opened their tenders in recent years to foreign companies, forcing the two domestic producesrs to cut prices.
Wires & Cables had revenues of about 275 million shekels in the first nine months of 1996, while Zion Cables' revenues were about 190 million shekels.
